subject: P2 stage-two seven-day review; read-only VPS evidence
timing_note: Snapshot taken about 36 minutes after scheduled review; not reconstructed at exact cutoff. Ops checks collected shortly afterwards.
method: One PostgreSQL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction for wallet/archived executions/candles; docker inspect/logs and existing observer files read separately.
Equity equals reserve plus instance cash; all holdings zero. Binding Realized is net of recorded entry/exit fees; fees must not be subtracted again.
Cumulative binding PnL and fees reconciled against all 214 hot plus zero archived fills using Python Decimal assertions.
Positive/negative sell fills are execution outcomes, not an assumption that partial fills are independent trades.
Adding recorded fees back is an arithmetic attribution only; slippage and execution timing remain.
Observer counts are sampled checks beginning October 23, before the latest P2 deployment that evening; not an uptime percentage or full seven-day coverage.
limitations: No forced reconnect, restart, backup/restore, browser/Telegram acceptance, new AI inference, build or test suite performed.
No changes to remote config, ledger, capital, processes, images, secrets or T0.
P3 health does not establish research readiness, budget usage or performance.
Logs bounded to latest 20000 lines and 24 hours; matching Pong timeout lines are not unique outage count.
